4163.title: Async-frame blocking time is omitted from stall attribution
4163.rootCauseOneLine: Async work frames always set blocksEventLoop=false, so their synchronous execution is excluded from slowestWork selection.
4163.proposedFix: Choose segment instrumentation that excludes waits and covers continuations; not eligible for an automatic simple fix.
4163.caveats: Synthetic synchronous work through the real wrapper and monitor; no third-party plugin, SQLite workload, or private host statistics reproduced.
